jobs_results.description:
We Breathe Life Into Data


At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease. 


As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way. 

The Opportunity at Komodo Health


The Analytics & Insights team at Komodo Health specializes in providing advanced analytics solutions to healthcare organizations, leveraging real-world data to drive insights and decision-making.


This role exists on the Analytics & Insights team to ensure the delivery of high-quality analytics products and services to our clients. The Analytics and Insights Manager plays a crucial role in driving client satisfaction, business growth, and innovation within the company.


Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have accomplished… 



Successfully delivered complex analytics projects on time and within budget, exceeding client expectations.
Built strong, collaborative relationships with key client stakeholders, resulting in high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.
Implemented process improvements that enhanced the efficiency and effectiveness of the Analytics Consulting team.
Developed the skills and capabilities of team members, fostering a high-performing and engaged team culture.
Contributed to the growth of the company by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within existing client accounts.
Demonstrated thought leadership in healthcare analytics, both internally and externally, through presentations, publications, and industry events.
Deepened your domain expertise across multiple key areas of interest to our clients, including but not limited to areas such as market landscaping, patient journey, line-of-therapy based analytics, segmentation & targeting, and analytical support for commercial assessments, forecasting, and BD & Licensing.

These are the essential job duties you will be responsible for … 



Manage the end-to-end delivery of analytics projects, from scoping and planning to execution and delivery.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Science, Engineering, and Product Management, to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing any concerns or issues that may arise during the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress and performance, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies as needed.
Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in healthcare analytics, incorporating new insights and technologies into our service offerings.

What you bring to Komodo Health (required):



Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics) or equivalent practical experience.
3-6 years of experience in healthcare analytics or related field, with a proven track record of delivering analytics solutions to clients.
Strong project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams and managing client relationships.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, or R.

Applies AI strategically, knowing how to use the right tools at the right time to solve problems or generate new ideas.

jobs_results.job_title: The Data School NY - Data Analyst Consultant
jobs_results.description: The Data School Consultant   Applications for this cohort will be considered on a rolling basis for cohorts beginning every 2 months. The next open cohort begins early January, 2027. Before applying to this role, please familiarize yourself with our aptitude-based selection process. Applications without an accompanying Tableau Public visualization will not be considered. The Information Lab has a simple mission: to help people make sense of data. We believe that companies that use data well will have better futures than those that don't. We have helped clients such as The Vanguard Group, JPMorgan Chase, PwC, JLL, and Paramount Global do just that through specializing in and consulting on the leading products for data visualization and data integration - Tableau and Alteryx - since 2011. As a consultant in The Data School program, you will experience on-the-job training that is far more immersive and rewarding than traditional roles. The Data School offers a 28-month contract where we will pay you to learn about data and technology from some of the greatest data experts across the world (including six Tableau Visionaries and three Alteryx ACEs). You'll undertake this intensive training over four months in our fantastic facility located on Union Square. Then, you'll showcase your new-found knowledge and skills with some of the biggest and most recognized blue-chip clients in the US in a series of placements following your training. But there's more to our training than just technical skills. With support from your coaches and the wider team, you will learn broader skills about storing, managing, and presenting data as well as personal skills to help boost your own confidence in becoming an exceptional consultant. We teach these skills in an inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone is responsible for each other's development and success. Our training and consulting focus on two software programs, Tableau and Alteryx, which you can excel at without coding knowledge. Our consultants come from different walks of life and many had never heard of Tableau before they stumbled across us (you can meet some of them here). The one thing they do have in common is a passion for problem-solving, especially with data and evidence. If you share the same inquisitive nature and have a drive to uncover the truth with data, then The Data School could be the perfect next chapter in your career. Everyone is welcome at The Information Lab and The Data School, no matter what your background is, your educational history, what you look like, or what topics you like to analyze in your own time. Diversity is an asset that helps us discover more varied stories in both our client's data and the rest of the world's. It suggests solutions and improvements for intractable problems in new and unexpected places. Will your passion help us solve the next generation of data problems? Show us and start your journey with The Data School - we ask you to create a dashboard with a dataset of your choice. For full details on applying, visit www.thedataschool.com/apply or see below for a summary. We would love to hear from you if you are: comfortable working with numbers analytical data-driven a people person a problem solver a confident communicator Facts and figures Location: Civic Hall, 124 E 14th St, New York, NY 10003 Contract: 28 month Vacation: 25 days paid time off per year Other benefits: Health Insurance, 401k (4% match), Laptop, Mobile Phone Application process (IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ CARFULLY) Find a dataset which interests you, the more you are interested in the subject the better the result will be. Download either the Tableau Public app or, if you are in full-time education you can apply for a Tableau Student Licence. Sign up and create a Tableau Public profile and publish your dashboard to it. Complete the application form and send us the URL to your dashboard in the box provided. Try to send in your first draft (when you're happy with it!) well in advance of the deadline for your chosen cohort. We will take a look and you will have the chance to iterate on your dashboard based on our feedback points. Some datasource resources (use Google also!): Makeover Monday, Kaggle, Data Commons, NYC Open Data, some other ideas. $66,300 - $71,300 a year Successful applicants will be offered a 28-month fixed-term contract within The Information Lab with a starting salary of $66,300 - $71,300 per year, with calendar year increases. We can, unfortunately, only accept applicants for this role who are eligible to work in the United States without work authorization or future sponsorship. We use the federal E-Verify program to validate the work authorization of all new hires. This is an in-person role based in New York City, with the possibility of a hybrid schedule after the 4-month training period. We recruit from all degree disciplines and academic backgrounds and welcome applications from career changers. We are proud of our diverse workplace and do not discriminate on gender, ethnicity, race, or sexual orientation.

jobs_results.job_title: 2027 Oliver Wyman - Data & Analytics Consulting - Analyst (m/f/d) - Berlin
jobs_results.description:
**Job Description:**

**Company:** Oliver Wyman

**Who we are**

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive. We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities. At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

Within Oliver Wyman, the Data & Analytics (DNA) division was established in 2017 and operates globally, with a particular focus on Europe. We are a dynamic and rapidly growing team of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm. Our work spans multiple industries, including Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation.

**What you will do**

As a member of Oliver Wyman’s Data & Analytics team, you will help clients make better decisions on some of their most important business challenges. You will combine analytical thinking, business understanding, and technical expertise to develop solutions that are both rigorous and practical. You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle: structuring the client’s problem, identifying the decisions that analysis needs to support, assessing the available data, and selecting an appropriate analytical approach. You will conduct analyses, build and validate models or tools, and translate the results into clear recommendations. As you develop, you will take increasing ownership of analytical modules and engage directly with clients and senior colleagues. You will also be an active member of the project team: sharing your ideas, discussing results with colleagues and clients, and helping turn analytical findings into meaningful recommendations and impact.

Examples of the work you could contribute to include:

- Building an AI toolkit to predict credit rating downgrades from news articles.

- Modeling portfolio decarbonization strategies for European banks.

- Optimizing promotions for an Asian health & beauty chain using advanced analytics.

- Validating a customer-facing Gen. AI chatbot for a bank.

- Designing credit risk models in Python for banks in Europe.

- Identifying supply chain risks using live data and AI.

**Why join us?**

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact**

Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex analytical problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact. Contribute to tailored Data & Analytics solutions across industries and geographies, applying analytical approaches to real client challenges. Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader**

From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work. Work alongside colleagues and clients at different levels, contributing your ideas and developing confidence through hands-on experience. Build the skills to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly and contribute effectively to client and team discussions.

**Learn without limits**

Expect a steep learning curve, as no two projects are the same. Expand your analytical and technical toolkit through exposure to a variety of challenges, industries, and technologies. Learn from experienced colleagues throughout your career, supported by a dedicated buddy, career adviser, and talent manager. Gain international exposure through opportunities to work across different cultures and, where projects require it, travel internationally.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture**

Work with genuine colleagues who collaborate across differences and support one another. Be part of an open and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences strengthen the work. Bring your curiosity, share your ideas, and contribute to a collaborative team that values different ways of thinking.

**Experience rewards that work for you**

Build your career in an environment that supports both professional growth and sustainable work-life quality. Benefit from flexibility designed to help you balance your career aspirations with your personal life. Have the support and resources you need to keep learning, growing, and performing at your best.

**Who can apply?**

- Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph. D degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Data Science, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering), with a strong academic track record.

- A data-driven mindset and proficiency with numbers, paired with the ability to explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner to clients and colleagues.

- Proficiency in at least one programming language, either Python or R, combined with an eagerness to continuously expand your knowledge of technologies and analytical methods.

- Strong commitment to teamwork and resilience in a creative, dynamic, and constantly changing environment.

- Willingness to travel and work on-site with clients as required.

- Language skills: business fluency in German and English.

- Interest in or experience with financial services and risk management is a plus.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV, cover letter, all employment references, and academic transcripts (including your high school diploma, Bachelor's degree, and Master's degree). If you would like to learn more about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or, alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

**What to expect during the interview process?**

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment - it’s challenging, exciting, and fun. With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us get to know you better and understand your strengths and interests but also enables you to learn more about our people and our business. If you want to learn more about our case interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on Linked. In and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh offers hybrid working arrangements that provide both the flexibility of mobile working and the benefits for collaboration, personal connections and professional development of working in the office. Employees are authorized to work remotely. If needed, some teams also schedule weekly “anchor days” where the entire team meets in person at the site office.
